name: Transformer sudden-pressure trip interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Receives the defined sudden-pressure protection contact for the assigned transformer tank.
description: Receives the defined sudden-pressure protection contact for the assigned transformer tank. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Sudden-pressure relay” at the input and “Tank-pressure trip initiation” at the output. Its application depends on transformer construction.
